title: The Honey Bee Waggle Dance
hook: How do forager honey bees share directions inside a dark hive?

scenes.title: The Figure-Eight
scenes.narration: Forager honey bees perform a specialized figure-eight movement on the honeycomb to share where resources like pollen and nectar are located.

scenes.title: Communicating Distance
scenes.narration: The distance to a food source is communicated through the length and duration of the straight waggle run.

scenes.title: Indicating Direction
scenes.narration: The direction of the food source is shown by the angle of the waggle run relative to the vertical axis of the honeycomb or the sun.

scenes.title: Sharing Samples
scenes.narration: Watching bees receive nectar samples and the scent of the flower patch to help them find it.

scenes.title: Acoustic Signals
scenes.narration: Inside the dark hive, bees use acoustics and wing vibrations to help signal quality, direction, and distance during the dance.

scenes.title: Scientific Discovery
scenes.narration: Austrian scientist Karl von Frisch earned a Nobel Prize in 1973 for discovering how this complex communication system works.
